WITH spending AS (
    SELECT c.country,
           c.id,
           c.name,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS total_minor
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.country, c.id, c.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT country,
           id,
           name,
           total_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY total_minor DESC) AS spending_rank
    FROM spending
)
SELECT country AS country_code,
       name AS customer_name,
       total_minor / 100.0 AS amount_dollars
FROM ranked
WHERE spending_rank = 1
ORDER BY country_code, customer_name, id

    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.country, c.id, c.name
),
ranked AS (
